description: This header file declares functions related to handling HTTP request headers within the WebKit browser extension for the WPEFramework. It includes function prototypes for setting, removing, and applying request headers, and references external WebKit types.

methods.name: SetRequestHeaders
methods.description: Function to set request headers for a WebKitWebPage, possibly using a user message.

methods.name: RemoveRequestHeaders
methods.description: Function to remove request headers from a WebKitWebPage.

methods.name: ApplyRequestHeaders
methods.description: Function to apply request headers to a WebKitURIRequest within a WebKitWebPage.
